# Get column names
col_names = df.columns.tolist()
film_name_col = col_names[0]
format_col = col_names[1]
date_col = col_names[2]

# Filter rows for Kodachrome Professional 35mm film
filtered = df[df[film_name_col].str.contains("Kodachrome Professional", case=False, na=False) &
              df[format_col].str.contains(r'35\s*mm', case=False, na=False)]

# Extract start years from date ranges
filtered_dates = filtered[date_col].astype(str)
start_years = filtered_dates.str.split('–').str[0].str.split('-').str[0]
start_years_numeric = start_years.str.extract(r'(\d+)')[0].astype(int)

# Find the earliest release year
if not start_years_numeric.empty:
    earliest_year = start_years_numeric.min()
    answer = str(earliest_year)  # Convert to string to match expected entity type
else:
    # Fallback: broader search for Professional and 35mm
    filtered_fallback = df[df[film_name_col].str.contains("Professional", case=False, na=False) &
                          df[format_col].str.contains("35", na=False)]
    if not filtered_fallback.empty:
        filtered_dates_fallback = filtered_fallback[date_col].astype(str)
        start_years_fallback = filtered_dates_fallback.str.split('–').str[0].str.split('-').str[0]
        start_years_numeric_fallback = start_years_fallback.str.extract(r'(\d+)')[0].astype(int)
        earliest_year = start_years_numeric_fallback.min()
        answer = str(earliest_year)
    else:
        answer = None
